$schema: Always-on analysis pass for produced agent systems — makes Pass 2 default-on in the fractal factory
description: Updates the fractal factory pipeline-design skill, pipeline-architect, artifact-designer, roster-planner, routing-planner, produced-agent schema, and produced-agent template to make the Analysis pass (Pass 2) default-on for every produced agent system. Adds analysis specialist type guidance, mandatory analysis artifacts, and canonical analysis+planning coordinator patterns.
assumptions: The fractal factory's existing 7-pass pipeline structure is unchanged
The pipeline-architect remains the sole decision-maker for pass inclusion
All four domain mapping examples in pipeline-design.md already include Analysis rows
The produced-agent schema and template are the authoritative references for prompt-writer and prompt-reviewer

designDecisions.rationale: A true greenfield generator with zero source material genuinely doesn't need analysis. But the architect must document why it's skipped — flipping the burden of proof.
Forces the pipeline-architect to explicitly reason about why analysis is unnecessary rather than silently omitting it. Reviewable by gap hunters and prompt reviewers.

designDecisions.decision: Analysis specialist is a subtype of Specialist, not a new agent type
designDecisions.rationale: Keeps the type system simple (specialist/coordinator/orchestrator/guide). Analysis specialist is guidance within the specialist type, not a separate category.
The extraction categories vary by domain (state transitions, attack vectors, behavior specs) but the invariants requirement is universal. This balances flexibility with rigor.
